title: Rainbow Formation (Dispersion)
guideExplore: Press Play — white light enters a droplet and spreads into a spectrum.
guideSlow: Slow speed lets you watch refraction, internal reflection, and dispersion step by step.
guideFast: Faster playback shows the full rainbow arc forming quickly.
conditionsHint: Rainbows form when sunlight refracts, reflects inside, and disperses in water droplets.
learnMore: Each color bends slightly differently — dispersion — so white sunlight spreads into ROYGBIV.
